summary: Eps 1-50 adapt manga chs 1-94 at an almost perfectly uniform 2 chapters/episode; the fandom wiki carries per-episode 'Adopted' fields with page splits, and its chapter pages carry a matching reverse mapping (relepisode) for every chapter 1-95, with ch 96 unmapped — confirming the stored ep51->95 anchor and Wikipedia's 'first 12 volumes / first 95 chapters' statement plus animefillerguide's 'continue from ch 96'. Structure surprises: the anime skips the manga's Garage Island prologue (chs 1-4) and grafts it in as flashbacks across eps 1-5/16/35; eps 39-40 adapt the Knights of Kingdom and RAVE0065 omakes (side stories, no mainline progress); and ep 41, typed filler in our DB and on filler sites, actually adapts ch 74 in full plus padding (type correction to mixed proposed). Eight boundary/title-matched anchors are high confidence via Wikipedia episode-title = chapter-title correlations independent of fandom; the rest are medium (single-wiki forward+reverse agreement inside a gap-free, endpoint-corroborated lattice). Context file's volume boundaries for v9/v10 are corrupted ('65-14'/'15-79'): true boundaries are v9=65-73, v10=74-79 (Wikipedia chapter list + fandom chapter pages) — the corruption almost certainly comes from omake chapters numbered 0014/0015 in those volumes being parsed as mainline.

structure.notes: Single 51-ep season (TBS 2001-2002), cumulative numbering = AniList 246 1-51, no conversion needed. Adaptation is linear and dense (2 ch/ep) apart from the rearranged chs 1-4 prologue grafts. Anime ends mid-v12 at ch 95; manga continue point after the series = ch 96 (v12). Arcs: Intro (eps 1-2), Lance (3-8), Dancing Thunder (9-12, ends ch 25), Shuda (13-18, chs 26-37), Mystery of Elie (19-26, chs 38-49), Tower of Din (27-38+41, chs 50-74), Symphonia (42-51, chs 75-95). Eps 39-40 are omake side-story adaptations sitting between eps 38 and 41 in broadcast order. CORRECTION to context data: volume boundaries v9=65-73, v10=74-79 (context file shows corrupted '65-14'/'15-79', likely from RAVE0014/0015 omake chapters printed in v9/v10).
